title: Stop the classification path inventing a second clock in a different timezone
objective: PR #99 made coverage_signal_context's `now` REQUIRED after a Level-2 found it inventing datetime.now(UTC) while its sibling currency_context required one, letting a router build one response payload from two moments with the suite green. This slice audits the whole defect class, classifies every site as ENTRY POINT or PARTICIPANT, converts the participants on the classification chain, and leaves the genuine boundaries alone with written reasons.

census_owned_by_this_slice.method: AST, not source pattern. A regex cannot see a signature a formatter split across lines, cannot distinguish a DEFAULT of None from a COMPARISON against None, and only finds spellings already thought of.
census_owned_by_this_slice.population_defect_census: 170 tracked files under apps/, of which 104 are Python and were parsed; 66 are TypeScript (apps/web) and were NOT searched.
census_owned_by_this_slice.population_blast_radius: 237 tracked .py repo-wide. Deliberately a different population from the defect census because the test tree is NOT under apps/ (0 of 104 match */tests/* or test_*), and the callers that pay the cost of a required parameter live in tests/.
census_owned_by_this_slice.the_ninth_site: apps/api/app/classify/engine.py:151 `as_of = as_of or date.today()`. Invisible to a `now or datetime.now(UTC)` search three ways at once: the parameter is `as_of` not `now`, the type is `date` not `datetime`, and the invention is `date.today()` -- which is LOCAL time while every other clock in this repository is UTC.
census_owned_by_this_slice.floor_not_total: 9 is a FLOOR. It is the count for the nine clock-ish parameter names and seven invention forms actually searched. A tenth in a spelling neither the brief nor this census enumerated remains possible.

ENTRY_POINT_change_nothing: adviser/abuse/admin.py::set_kill_switch -- sole caller is the argparse CLI main(); an operator has no moment to pass, and each command is a single self-contained write with no sibling clock-consumer to disagree with. Comment added; behaviour unchanged.

ingest/reconcile_coverage.py::assert_no_coverage_contradictions -- a test-assertion boundary invoked directly by a provider slice's own test. Sources the clock on an explicit line rather than through an optional parameter, precisely so it does not re-create the hazard.
PARTICIPANT_converted: classify/orm.py::classify_offer (as_of required; was a RELOCATOR -- forwarded None to the callee that invented)
classification.CALL_SITE_defect_fixed: publish/publisher.py::_do_publish already held a UTC `now` (used at :369, :378, :447) and called classify_offer(offer, version) without it, dropping the classification to local date.today(). Now passes as_of=now.date(). Zero signature change, zero test churn.
DEFERRED_with_reasons: read_api/search.py::search_published_offers -- public read surface, 0 production cost, 5 test call sites. Deferred only to keep this slice one causal chain.
publish/publisher.py::publish_candidate -- 0 production cost, 14 test call sites; belongs with the scan-run slice.

ingest/reconcile.py::reconcile_scan and publish/publisher.py::publish_scan -- these invent SEPARATELY inside one run_provider_scans, so a single scan run uses two moments. A real second finding that needs its own evidence, not a tail added to this one. 26 test call sites for reconcile_scan alone.

defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.what: coverage_signal_context's docstring states 'Both production callers already pass a clock, so requiring it costs nothing and removes the capability.' That is true of ARITY and false of NULLABILITY.
defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.how: find_coverage_mismatches forwarded `now=None` into it, satisfying 'must be supplied' while supplying None, and reconcile_coverage.py:183 (inside assert_no_coverage_contradictions) called find_coverage_mismatches(session) with no clock at all. There is no static type checker on the Python side of this repository, so `now: datetime` caught nothing.
defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.measured_behaviour: It does NOT fail open. assess_staleness(fetched_at, None, schedule) raises TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for -: 'NoneType' and 'datetime.datetime'. It stayed invisible only because the data reaching that helper never includes a snapshot with a fetched_at. A LATENT CRASH waiting for the first Wave-3 provider slice with real evidence, not a defect the suite had ruled out.
defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.corroboration: Independently confirmed by mutation: dropping the clock at reconcile_coverage.py:138 killed 4 named integration tests with that exact TypeError at reconcile.py:271.

measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.claim_as_first_written: An offer whose available_until fell in the gap was published as free while its own timestamp said the window had closed.
measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.measurement: FALSE. A non-null available_until yields Z2_TEMPORARY_OR_CONDITIONAL on BOTH sides of the boundary; as_of never flips the zero-cost class. Verified by executing classify() at as_of=2029-06-01 and as_of=2030-06-01 against identical facts.
measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.corrected_claim: as_of changes the published REASON, not the class. The same facts produce either 'Offer availability ended on 2029-12-31.' or 'Offer has a bounded availability window ending 2029-12-31.' The second states that a closed window is still open. A false sentence is a smaller defect than a false class, and still one this product does not ship.
measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.where_corrected: The engine.py docstring and the publisher.py comment were rewritten BEFORE commit. A test now asserts the class does NOT move, so if that ever changes, this audit's own conclusion fails loudly rather than silently becoming an understatement.

l2_disposition.verdict: FAILED on evidence and guard; the CODE was found correct under seven falsification experiments.
l2_disposition.everything_below_is_additive: No code change, no behaviour change. The production diff from the first submission is unchanged.

l2_finding_1_the_one_that_mattered.what_i_proved: Dropping `as_of=now.date()` at _do_publish is KILLED. That kills on ARITY.
l2_finding_1_the_one_that_mattered.what_i_failed_to_prove: That the RIGHT MOMENT is chosen. Those are different properties and the first does not imply the second.
l2_finding_1_the_one_that_mattered.the_surviving_mutation: as_of=now.astimezone().date() -- same instant, local calendar date, argument still supplied, no import change. Exactly base behaviour.
l2_finding_1_the_one_that_mattered.reproduced_independently: SURVIVED at 2967 passed, exit 0, against a database proven live first. The evaluator was right.
l2_finding_1_the_one_that_mattered.why_no_behavioural_test_can_close_it: CI runs python:3.13-slim with tzname ('UTC','UTC'), where now.date() and now.astimezone().date() are equal by construction. A test that cannot fail in the environment that runs it is not a guard.
l2_finding_1_the_one_that_mattered.fix: publisher.py added to _AUDITED_MODULES, and a new STRUCTURAL test -- test_a_clock_argument_passes_the_inherited_moment_not_a_re_derived_one -- requires every now=/as_of= argument in an audited module to pass the inherited moment, forbidding astimezone/localtime/today/now/utcnow/fromtimestamp/mktime/gmtime/combine inside it.
l2_finding_1_the_one_that_mattered.verified: That named test now FAILS on the exact L2 mutation, reporting `line 416: as_of=now.astimezone().date()  re-derives via ['astimezone']`.

l2_finding_2_participant_list_drift.what: The contract claimed SEVEN converted participants; the PARTICIPANTS list pinned SIX. reconcile_coverage had no signature test.
l2_finding_2_participant_list_drift.why_it_mattered: Re-optionalising it WITHOUT an `or` fallback survives green -- the RELOCATOR shape, which forwards None onward instead of inventing locally, and which the fallback-shape guard structurally cannot see. That is the same shape I diagnosed as PR #99's defect.
l2_finding_2_participant_list_drift.fix: reconcile_coverage added to PARTICIPANTS, and a new test -- test_the_participant_list_matches_the_contract -- reads PARTICIPANT_converted out of this file and fails if the two ever disagree again. A hand-maintained list drifts; this makes the drift fail a test.

l2_corrected_claims.search_published_offers: WRONG as stated. There is ONE production caller, read_api/router.py:306, and it passes now=now. Correct statement: 1 production caller, 0 production EDITS required. The deferral remains SAFE and the decision stands; only my reason was wrong.
l2_corrected_claims.publish_candidate: WRONG as stated. ONE production caller, publisher.py:625, which passes now=now. Same correction, same conclusion: deferral safe, reason wrong.
l2_corrected_claims.apps_web_file_count: WRONG, and wrong in the worst way -- INFERRED BY ARITHMETIC rather than measured. I wrote '66 TypeScript files in apps/web' from 170 minus 104. Measured: apps/ has 170 tracked, 66 of them non-Python, but only 57 tracked files live in apps/web and only 43 are TS/JS. The other 9 non-Python files are elsewhere under apps/. Subtraction is not measurement.
l2_corrected_claims.clock_invention_call_sites: The bare figure '52' does not survive its own breakdown and should never have been published as a scalar without its definition. Measured now over 238 tracked .py repo-wide, three defensible definitions give three answers: (A) strict wall-clock source = 22 apps / 33 tests / 55 repo; (B) A plus time.time()/time_ns = same; (C) B plus calls to _now-style helpers = 48 apps / 33 tests / 81 repo. My original 52 was definition (C) restricted to apps/ AND polluted with 2 time.monotonic() calls, which are not wall clocks at all and have no frame of reference. The evaluator measures 29/35/72 under a fourth definition I do not hold. The honest resolution is that this number is definition-dependent and was NEVER load-bearing: no conclusion in this slice rested on it. The load-bearing census was the count of INVENTING FUNCTIONS = 9, which the evaluator independently confirmed with 5/5 positive and 4/4 negative controls.

l2_bidirectionality_recorded.what_i_said: Only the overclaim direction -- an expired window published as still open.
l2_bidirectionality_recorded.what_is_true: The defect is BIDIRECTIONAL, verified by executing the classifier at explicit dates for one instant in three zones.
l2_bidirectionality_recorded.east_of_utc: At UTC+14, instant 2029-12-31T23:00Z has local date 2030-01-01. UTC says the window is OPEN; the local frame emits 'Offer availability ended on 2029-12-31.' That WITHHOLDS a true free claim.
l2_bidirectionality_recorded.west_of_utc: At UTC-7, instant 2030-01-01T03:00Z has local date 2029-12-31. UTC says CLOSED; the local frame emits 'Offer has a bounded availability window ending 2029-12-31.' That ASSERTS an expired claim.
l2_bidirectionality_recorded.why_it_matters: This project weights a wrongly-WITHHELD claim equally with a wrongly-asserted one. Describing only one direction understated the defect.
l2_bidirectionality_recorded.two_fields_not_one: Gate 5 passes the SAME tuple to reasons AND blocking_conditions. Measured: both differ across the boundary and both carry the identical false sentence. It is two published fields, not one.

l2_calibration_against_the_finding.cuts_against: The shipped container runs UTC (python:3.13-slim, tzname ('UTC','UTC')), so date.today() and now.date() are equal there and the defect CANNOT fire in the deployed service.
l2_calibration_against_the_finding.cuts_for: It CAN fire via the documented host-side CLI, `python -m app.ingest.runner`, which runs in the operator's local zone.
l2_calibration_against_the_finding.why_both_halves: Stating only the second half is advocacy, and stating only the first half would excuse the defect. The honest position is that this is a real defect on a real documented path with a bounded blast radius, not a live production incident.

l2_durable_lesson_windows_tz.finding: Windows CPython has NO time.tzset() and SILENTLY IGNORES the TZ environment variable. Verified on this host: hasattr(time,'tzset') is False, and after setting TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati, time.tzname is still ('Mountain Standard Time','Mountain Daylight Time').
l2_durable_lesson_windows_tz.consequence: Any TZ-based measurement of this defect on this host reports NO DIVERGENCE, which reads as the defect being ABSENT. It had to be measured in a Linux container.
l2_durable_lesson_windows_tz.why_this_is_the_important_half: This is not a Windows trivia note. It is an instrument that fails silently toward the comfortable answer, in the same family as a -k that matches nothing and a mutation that never applies. It is the reason my own not-verified item 2 stayed unverified rather than being quietly resolved the wrong way.

l2_error_i_made_during_remediation.what: My first re-run of the semantic mutation reported KILLED with 279 errors. That verdict was FABRICATED BY MY OWN ENVIRONMENT.
l2_error_i_made_during_remediation.cause: I recreated the Postgres container and ran CREATE DATABASE mutdb 8 seconds later, piped its output to Out-Null, and printed 'mutdb ready' UNCONDITIONALLY without checking the exit code. Postgres was not yet accepting connections. Every integration test then failed with 'FATAL: database mutdb does not exist', and the harness read a non-zero exit as KILLED.
l2_error_i_made_during_remediation.how_i_caught_it: The failure pattern was implausible -- 279 errors in test_admin_migration have nothing to do with a timezone change in publisher.py -- and the run took 416s instead of ~110s.
l2_error_i_made_during_remediation.why_it_was_dangerous: Had I accepted it, I would have reported to the orchestrator that L2 Finding 1 was wrong. A false KILL is worse than a false SURVIVE because it confirms whatever you were hoping for.
l2_error_i_made_during_remediation.durable_fix: mutate.ps1 now proves the database is reachable BEFORE running anything, and ABORTS rather than returning a verdict. Demonstrated: the precondition was shown to fail against the still-absent mutdb before mutdb was created and VERIFIED present in pg_database.
